entities.name: tbl_supplier_master

fields.name: supplier_id
fields.description: Surrogate primary key (auto-increment).

fields.name: supplier_name
fields.description: Supplier display name. Required per AC-001.

fields.name: place
fields.description: Supplier location. Auto-populated into Inward form on supplier select (HLD AC-022). Required per AC-001.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Soft-delete flag. AC-002 — false hides supplier from Inward form dropdown. Hard delete forbidden per DS-008.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Server-default insert timestamp via TimestampMixin.

indexes: INDEX ix_supplier_master_is_active ON (is_active) — supports active-only list filter (DF active dropdowns).
constraints: CHECK supplier_name <> '' (enforced at Pydantic min_length=1 + DB default behavior).

entities.name: tbl_staff_master

fields.name: staff_id
fields.description: Surrogate primary key.

fields.name: staff_name
fields.description: Staff member name. Required per AC-004.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Soft-delete flag. AC-005 — false hides staff from Inward/Sales/Adjustment dropdowns. Hard delete forbidden per DS-008.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Server-default insert timestamp.

indexes: INDEX ix_staff_master_is_active ON (is_active) — supports active-only staff dropdown queries (used in S2 by loading_staff, verified_by, entered_by).

entities.name: tbl_dealer_master

fields.name: dealer_id
fields.description: Surrogate primary key.

fields.name: dealer_name
fields.description: Dealer display name. Required per AC-007.

fields.name: place
fields.description: Dealer location. Auto-populated into Sales form on dealer select (AC-029). Required per AC-007.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Soft-delete flag. AC-008 — false hides dealer from Sales form dropdown and report filter.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Server-default insert timestamp.

indexes: INDEX ix_dealer_master_is_active ON (is_active) — supports active-only Sales form + report filter feeds.

entities.name: tbl_grade_master

fields.name: grade_id
fields.description: Surrogate primary key.

fields.name: grade_code
fields.description: Canonical grade code (e.g. '1', '2', '2A', '4', '5', '6', '1OB', 'OB', 'DIM'). UNIQUE per AC-011.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Soft-delete flag. AC-012 — deactivated grades disappear from Design-Grade combinations via JOIN filter.

indexes: UNIQUE INDEX uq_grade_master_grade_code ON (grade_code) — enforces AC-011; also serves repo.get_by_code(code) lookup for pre-insert uniqueness check.
INDEX ix_grade_master_is_active ON (is_active) — supports active-only grade lookups for design-grade JOINs.
constraints: UNIQUE (grade_code) — AC-011. Maps to HTTP 409 via IntegrityError handler.
CHECK grade_code <> '' (enforced via Pydantic constr min_length=1, strip_whitespace).
entities.notes: No created_at column — read-mostly canonical reference data per F-004; created_at intentionally omitted (LLD frontend type Grade also omits it).

entities.name: tbl_trading_design_master

fields.name: design_id
fields.description: Surrogate primary key.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Tile size descriptor (e.g. '16X10'). Required per AC-013.

fields.name: design_name
fields.description: Trading-design display name (e.g. '16X10 Ridges'). Required per AC-013. Distinct from any manufactured-tile design list (PRD constraint).

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Soft-delete flag. AC-015 — false hides design from Inward/Sales/Adjustment design dropdowns.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Server-default insert timestamp.

indexes: INDEX ix_trading_design_master_is_active ON (is_active) — supports active-only design dropdown for transaction forms.

entities.name: tbl_design_grade_map

fields.name: map_id
fields.description: Surrogate primary key (avoids needing a composite PK for the FK references from future ledger writes).

fields.name: design_id
fields.description: FK → tbl_trading_design_master.design_id. Required.

fields.name: grade_id
fields.description: FK → tbl_grade_master.grade_id. Required.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Soft-delete flag. AC-017 — false hides combination from future form grade rows; historical transactions unaffected (HLD R-005 mitigation).

indexes: UNIQUE INDEX uq_design_grade_map_design_grade ON (design_id, grade_id) — enforces AC-016 + serves repo.get_by_pair lookup.

INDEX ix_design_grade_map_design_id ON (design_id) — supports list_active_by_design (HLD DF-006 contract / GET /designs/{id}/grades). Without this, the unique index works but pushes the engine to scan more rows for the WHERE design_id=? AND is_active=true predicate.
INDEX ix_design_grade_map_is_active ON (is_active) — supports admin list_mappings active-only filter.
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (design_id) REFERENCES tbl_trading_design_master(design_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT — V1 has no hard delete (DS-008); RESTRICT is belt-and-braces against future regressions.
FOREIGN KEY (grade_id) REFERENCES tbl_grade_master(grade_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT.
UNIQUE (design_id, grade_id) — AC-016. Maps to HTTP 409 via IntegrityError handler.
entities.notes: No created_at column — junction table; LLD frontend type DesignGradeMap also omits it.

migrations.upgrade_summary: create_table for all 6 master tables in dependency order (supplier, staff, dealer, grade, trading_design, design_grade_map). Adds UNIQUE(grade_code), UNIQUE(design_id, grade_id), FK(design_grade_map.design_id, design_grade_map.grade_id) with ON DELETE RESTRICT, INDEX(is_active) per table, INDEX(design_id) on design_grade_map.
migrations.downgrade_summary: drop_table in reverse dependency order — tbl_design_grade_map first (to drop FK constraints), then tbl_trading_design_master, tbl_grade_master, tbl_dealer_master, tbl_staff_master, tbl_supplier_master.
migrations.generator: alembic revision --autogenerate (DS-009). Reviewer verifies generated DDL matches this schema before commit. Hand-add op.create_index lines for the is_active + design_id indices if autogenerate misses them.

query_patterns_supported.description: List active masters for dropdown feeds (per entity).
query_patterns_supported.query: SELECT * FROM tbl_<entity>_master WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY <name_col> ASC

query_patterns_supported.description: List active grades for a design (HLD DF-006, AC-019, GET /designs/{id}/grades).
query_patterns_supported.query: SELECT m.grade_id, g.grade_code FROM tbl_design_grade_map m JOIN tbl_grade_master g ON g.grade_id = m.grade_id WHERE m.design_id = :did AND m.is_active = TRUE AND g.is_active = TRUE
SELECT * FROM tbl_design_grade_map WHERE design_id = :did AND grade_id = :gid
